name: sfx.freesound
title: Sound fetch (Freesound)
summary: The Freesound provider of sfx.fetch: bring Freesound sounds into a job as WAV files, measured (attack, loudest stretch, peak), with each sound's licence and a ready credit line in credits.json. Needs the freesound_api_key secret file and network access.
description: Looks every sound up on Freesound (API v2) first, so a sound whose licence is not in `licenses` fails the job before anything is downloaded. Then it downloads each sound's high-quality MP3 preview (an API key gives previews; Freesound's original files need its OAuth2 login, which this tool does not do), converts it to WAV at `sample_rate` and `channels`, and measures it: `onset_s` (where it becomes audible, so a hit can be placed on its cut), `loudest_s` (where its loudest one-second stretch starts, so a texture or ambience can start from its busiest part) and `peak_db`. credits.json lists every sound's title, author, link, licence and a credit line. Licences differ per sound: CC0 needs no credit, CC BY needs the credit line, CC BY-NC forbids commercial use. Identical requests reuse the earlier download (cache "reuse"); submit with cache "off" to download again. Reads the freesound_api_key secret file (an API key from freesound.org/apiv2/apply); the key is sent only in the Authorization header to the API, never to the preview server, and never appears in results or logs. Retries 429, 5xx and network errors.

sounds.description: The sounds to fetch, in order: a Freesound id as a string (the file is named freesound-<id>.wav) or {id, name}.

oneOf.description: A sound with an explicit output name.

name.description: Output file name without .wav, e.g. door writes door.wav. Unique inside one call.

licenses.description: Refuse any sound whose licence is not one of these: cc0, by, by-nc, sampling+ (invalid-input before any download). Omit to accept every licence.

sample_rate.description: Sample rate of the WAV files in Hz. Default 48000.

channels.description: 1 (mono) or 2 (stereo; a mono sound is copied to both). Default 2.

format.description: WAV encoding: wav (16-bit), wav24 (24-bit) or wav32f (32-bit float). Default wav24.

sounds.description: One entry per sound, in input order.

file.description: Its WAV output, e.g. door.wav (ref job:<id>/door.wav).

license.description: Licence code: cc0, by, by-nc, sampling+ or other.

author.description: The Freesound user who uploaded it.

attribution.description: A credit line: title, author, link and licence.

onset_s.description: Where the sound becomes audible in the file, in seconds.

loudest_s.description: Where the loudest one-second stretch starts (0 when the sound is shorter).

peak_db.description: Sample peak of the WAV in dBFS.

source.description: What was downloaded: Freesound's high-quality MP3 preview.
